snippet.title: Rain98 - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3738760/Rain98_Demo/

A new trailer revealed at The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026.
The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026にて解禁されたRain98の2nd PV。

---------

From today's Tokyo to 1998 Tokyo.
Rain98 is a Lo-Fi psychological suspense game that has you share a strange everyday life with Reina Amehara (V.A.: Rio Tsuchiya), a girl who dubs herself "Angolmois."
Talk with Reina, help her with whatever request she throws your way, and from time to time, journey together through a rainy Tokyo.
Live through those lonely days together as you carry forward the ritual to end the world.

現代から、1998年の東京へ。
『Rain98』はアンゴルモアを名乗る謎の少女・雨原玲奈（CV：土屋李央）との奇妙な同居生活を描く、Lo-Fi × サイコサスペンスADVです。
玲奈と言葉を交わし、世話を焼き、ともに雨の降る街を歩く。
ふたりだけの日常を重ねながら、“世界滅亡の儀式”を進めていきましょう。

・Wishlist on Steam：https://s.team/a/3498720
・Discord：https://discord.gg/RG6NU7cx3w 
・X：https://x.com/csharp4r4ct3r
・YouTube：https://www.youtube.com/@csharp4r4ct3r
